def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find cross
    vr=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]!=0 for r in range(H))]
    hr=[r for r in range(H) if all(g[r][c]!=0 for c in range(W))]
    vr=vr[0]; hr=hr[0]; col=g[0][vr]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if out[r][c]!=0: continue
            qr = hr-1 if r<hr else hr+1
            qc = vr-1 if c<vr else vr+1
            d = max(abs(r-qr), abs(c-qc))
            if d%2==1: out[r][c]=4
    return out
